description: This file defines the socket initialization logic for a real-time dashboard backend, setting up namespaces for metrics and users, handling connection/disconnection events, and periodically emitting metric updates while persisting some data to the database.

methods.name: initSockets(io)
methods.description: Initializes socket.io namespaces for /metrics and /users, sets up connection/disconnection event handlers, and periodically emits metric updates while saving data to the database.
